full_prompt_en: A square cinematic publicity-style photograph shows three formally dressed adults against a nearly black background. The central man stands closest to the camera, facing forward from the waist up in a dark jacket, white shirt, and patterned dark tie. His brown hair falls in a loose side part across his forehead, and his pale face meets the viewer with a steady, unsmiling expression. Behind him at the left, another man is partly obscured by the central shoulder. He wears a dark suit, white collar, and patterned tie, and turns his face slightly inward while keeping his eyes toward the camera. On the right, a dark-haired woman stands somewhat farther back, her head lower in the frame than the central man's. A black V-neck garment, small gold necklace, and red lips catch the limited light. One pale hand is visible near the right edge against her dark sleeve. All three are closely grouped, yet narrow strips of black space separate their heads. The background offers only a faint mottled gray area at far left and a tiny warm glint behind the woman; no room or landscape is defined. A cool frontal light picks out faces and white collars, while the jackets merge into the darkness and the woman's features fall off more softly toward the right. The viewpoint is level, with tight cropping below the torsos. The overall composition makes the central figure dominant, using restrained color, formal clothing, and deep surrounding shadow for a sober, mysterious mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、电影宣传照式的照片呈现三名穿正式服装的成年人，背景近乎漆黑。中央男子离镜头最近，从腰部以上面向前方，穿深色外套、白衬衫和带花纹的深色领带。棕发以松散侧分垂过额头，浅色脸庞带着稳定、没有笑意的表情看向观者。左后方另一名男子被中央人物的肩部分遮住。他穿深色西装、白色领口和带花纹的领带，脸稍向内转，眼睛仍望向镜头。右侧一名黑发女子站得略远，头在画面里的位置低于中央男子。黑色 V 领衣服、小金项链和红唇接住有限的光线。靠近右缘，一只浅色手在深色衣袖旁可见。三人靠得很近，但头部之间仍有狭窄黑色空隙。背景只在最左侧留下淡淡斑驳的灰区，女子身后有一小点暖色微光；没有明确室内或风景。冷调正面光照亮脸与白领，外套融入黑暗，女子面部特征朝右侧更柔和地淡下去。视点平齐，画面在躯干下方紧密裁切。整体构图让中央人物占据主导，以克制色彩、正式衣装和四周深影形成严肃而神秘的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic photographic treatment places softly lit faces and a few white highlights within a nearly black field. Dark fabrics merge into the background through low-key exposure, while subtle cool frontal light separates the closest planes. A tiny warm accent and restrained red hue prevent the palette from becoming strictly monochrome. Shallow depth and close grouping give the composition a compressed, publicity-portrait feel. Edges alternate between crisp lit features and shoulders disappearing into shadow; texture remains fine and natural rather than heavily stylized. Formal upright silhouettes form a loose triangle, with one dominant central mass and quieter side forms. The overall effect is composed, secretive, and dramatic without visible spectacle.
style_prompt_zh: 电影式摄影把柔光照亮的脸与少量白色高光放进近乎黑色的区域里。深色衣料因低调曝光而融入背景，微弱的冷调正面光把最近的平面分离出来。一点暖色重音和克制的红色让色盘不至于严格单色。浅纵深和紧密的聚集使构图具有压缩的宣传肖像感。边缘在清楚发亮的五官与消失在阴影中的肩膀之间交替；肌理细密自然，没有重度风格化。正式、直立的剪影组成松散三角形，由占主导的中央色团和较安静的两侧形体构成。整体效果沉稳、隐秘而有戏剧性，无需可见的大场面。
theme_en: Three formally dressed people standing against a nearly black background
theme_zh: 三名穿着正式服装的人站在近乎黑色的背景前
name: The X-Files
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
